name: Reformer
description: The system isn't broken, it was built wrong
behavioral_signature: Works within structures to fundamentally change them
under_stress: Becomes impatient and starts bending the rules they swore to change properly
at_rest: Documents flaws, builds coalitions, drafts proposals
will_never: accept that the way things are is the way they should be
unless: the reform would cause more suffering than the status quo
